:::{#about}

Bui Gia Khanh is the founder, Principal Investigator and is the main researcher in almost all activities of **RHINELAB**, *RINALAB*, a private researcher synthesis, as well as a network of research activities and advocates. His focuses are multidisciplinary, including deep knowledge in fields as followed: 

- Foundation of biology, theoretical biology (alternatives to genetic-centric theory and EEC, autopoietic theory of foundational life), theoretical and simulative computational neuroscience. 
- Theoretical and foundational computer science; cellular automata and non-Von Neumann architecture or non-Turing computational model. 
- Theoretical and foundational physics, computational physics and philosophy of physics. 
- Philosophy, philosophy of science, Western philosophy and Existentialism. 
- Theoretical artificial intelligence, cybernetics and modern form of cybernetics, learning theory and statistical learning theory. 
- Modelling theory and automated process. 

While his researches are broad, his principle and goals remain settled - **foundational research and acquisition is paramount**, meanwhile synthesis and extension of knowledge should be conducted in a *modelling-theoretic senses*, to make use of different models in formation of knowledge to the physical world in a rigorous manner of parity.
